body: server/worldcrisis/worldcrisis.go: Crisis{Phase,LeyIntegrity,Outcome,PhaseDeadline,objectiveTimes}; Start/Tick(Omens→Burrow→Emergence→SplitWar→FinalWindow→Resolution)/CompleteObjective/LeyDecay/Status/Reset/SetPhaseDuration; concurrentGateMet (≥3 objectives in ConcurrentGate window); auto-fail on LEY=0; 22 tests. protocol: PacketWorldCrisisUpdate=14, PacketObjectiveComplete=15. server-go: crisis goroutine ticks every 250ms, broadcasts JSON {phase,ley_integrity,phase_deadline_unix,outcome} to all clients; PATCHes IDUNA on phase change. idunaclient.PatchWorldEvent(id,phase,ley).
title: S76-05: World Crisis phase machine — server/worldcrisis (6-phase state machine, LEY_INTEGRITY decay, concurrent objective gate, 22 tests), PacketWorldCrisisUpdate/ObjectiveComplete, server-go goroutine ticks+broadcasts, idunaclient.PatchWorldEvent; 29 packages pass
